content.short: Puffer Finance is a native liquid restaking protocol on Ethereum that lowers barriers for node operators.
content.description:
Puffer Finance is a premier native liquid restaking protocol (nLRP) built on the foundational layer of EigenLayer, designed to decentralize and secure the Ethereum network. By allowing participants to become validators with significantly less ETH than the standard requirement, the protocol fosters a more inclusive and resilient validator set. Users who stake ETH receive pufETH, a highly composable liquid token that simultaneously earns Ethereum staking rewards and additional yields from Actively Validated Services (AVS) on EigenLayer.

Utilizing its proprietary "SecureSigner" technology—a remote signing tool powered by TEE hardware—Puffer Finance protects node operators from common slashing penalties, ensuring maximum capital security. The platform operates primarily on Ethereum and focuses on providing a professional-grade, non-custodial environment for restakers. Through its commitment to technological innovation and community-driven decentralization, Puffer Finance has become a cornerstone of the restaking economy, empowering users to maximize their returns while securing the future of the decentralized web.
content.meta: Puffer Finance provides native liquid restaking and secure validator infrastructure for the Ethereum ecosystem.
